book.name: iMatiu
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMatiu

content: Ofwo angbeka ikwɔ
<<Ka fwikwɔ ba na, di ema kpaa a wa fwo ema ikwɔ.
Lubana li mi itɔ ofɛ ngwi ema fwo angbeka ikwɔ ma, ngwi ema kpaa a ka fwo ema ikwɔ, di li itɔ ofɛ ngwi ema kye ofwo angbeka ikwɔ ma, ngwi a ka kye fwo ema ikwɔ aali.
<<Kyɔsinɛ ngwi abu di ofufu ekwɔ mi inɛ mbi ongwunabu kpaa ngwi abu gbɛwɛbyi otsokpla nwodzɛ inɛ mbi abu na ba?
Ka kyɔsinɛse abu ka nya ongwunabu gbɛɛ, <Detse nin dulu abu ofufu ekwɔ mi inɛ,> ngwi alonɔ duu otsokpla wodzɛ inɛ mbi abu?
Ema emi ikpala, ababɔ kyi dulu otsokpla nwodzɛ inɛ mbi abu, ta abu ka dinɛ saan odulu ofufu ekwɔ nwodzɛ inɛ mbi ongwunabu nani.
<<Ka kye ungwɔ nle saan nu obwe ba na, dika kye itagwude mgbi ema ngwuta la obyia ba, kini ema kyɔ ngha yɔ, a ka kye atafɔ tɔdɔ ma, di kyata kye ema kye nghalu ambulu-ambulu.
Bɔ, pita, tsaabɔ
<<Bɔ ta a ka kye nu ema, pita ta ema ka tu, tsaabɔ ta a ka kwulu ema ofɛ.
Bana ali inggisɛ nbɔ duu li gbɛ, inggisɛ npita li tu, inggisɛ ndi tsaabɔ, ofɛ ka kwulu mi ikye mgban.
<<Li emɛ mbi ema, kini ongwan bɔn ibredi, se o ka kye ikwutsɛ nun?
Naadi kini o bɔn mmbweni, ngwi o ka kye ifa nun?
Kini ema, ama nli obube, kpaa ye okye umba osuse nu engwɛ ema ma, ka kyɔsinɛse ngwi Otsema ongwi esho ka kye umba osuse nu ama nbɔn ba!
Nghanɛ mi alungwɔ duu, kyɔ yi inggisɛ angbeka dafi ema mina gbɛɛ a ki kyɔ yi ema mani, bana li mi ungwɔnɛ ngwi Ola bɛyi emi Oyegbɔ kwulu ngwuo aani.
Ofɛ okpenge yi ogbada
<<Kaka onufɛ ogalu okpenge. Lubana onufɛ ogalu otsɛɛ yi ofɛ ogbada-gbada li ofɛ olu imbe odzili-dzili, inggisɛ kwuba le nyɛ ele.
Kpaa onufɛ ogalu ogyɛngyɛ yi ofɛ okpenge na le lu imbe oshishe, ma li inggisɛ gwee ta kpatsɛ ofɛ nani.
Ekwɔ yi owawan
<<Gbɛwɛbyi oyegbɔ emi atsika. A li ba mbi ema kye okpa mmala tukwu ewo, kpaa mi idzidzɛ a li emi idukwlɛbɛ obube.
Mi owawa mgbi ama ema ka difwi ma. Inggisɛ ka yagba shɛ mntsa mi olumu, naadi shɛ olumu mi ato gbɛɛ?
Li ngha ngwi ekwɔ osuse duu li wa owawa osuse aali, kpaa ekwɔ obube yɔ li wa owawa obube.
Ekwɔ osuse ka yagba wa owawa obube ba, ekwɔ obube dika wa owawa osuse gbɛ ba.
Ali ekwɔ ta nwa owawa osuse bayɔ, a ka kye dzɛlu di kye ngwuta wokɛ ola.
Nghanɛ, li mi owawa mgbi ama ngwi ema ka difwi ma.
<<Li ali inggisɛ nkwu ani gbɛɛ, <Otsɛ, Otsɛ,> ta ka kaka esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho ba, kpaa sede li ongwu nkyɔ mi itukwu mgbi Otsani ongwu ndzɛ esho nani.
Inggisɛ kwuba ka nya ani mi egbe na gbɛɛ, <Otsɛ, Otsɛ, eyi yegbɔ mi iyi mgbi abu, di lɔ onodzi emɛsɛ onya tɔ di kyungwɔ ama okwulewo angbeka kwuba mi iyi mgbi abu baa?>
Ta ani ka nya ma mi ododa gbɛɛ, <Ani ye ema ba. Lu enggengga na, ema emi ali ibwubwe ntonɛni!>
Inggisɛ efa ama ombɛ ozu
<<Nghanɛ ali inggisɛ nfwo elodzɛ mgbi ani ntonɛ di kyɔ mi ele dzɛ dafi inggisɛ okwiinɛ ngwu mbɛ ozu mgban mi ikye ikwutsɛ mani.
Mmbwo kya, akpeni kyɛɛ, awo di fa tsɛkɛ ozu nani, nghaduu i yagba gbobu ba, ikyesinɛ a wo itan mi ikye ikwutsɛ.
Nghaduu ali inggisɛ nfwo odzɛ mgbi ani ntonɛ di kyɔ mi ele bayɔ, o dzɛ dafi ikwangha inggisɛ ngwu mbɛ ozu mgban mi ikye mfyan mani.
Mmbwo kya, akpeni kyɛɛ, awo di fa tsɛkɛ ozu nani, i yulu tukwu esɛ.>>
Onɔ ngwi iYesu ngyɛlu ogbɔ ungwɔ ntonɛ nɛ, i kwulu ibyi inggisɛ ntona ewo mi otsootso mgban,
ikyesinɛ o tsungwɔ dafi inggisɛ ndzɛ yi mfye, li dafi mgbi etsetse mgbi ama, ama otso ola ba.
